source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public Exodus 22:1 maps to Hebrew Exod 21:37; public 22:2–31 maps to Hebrew 22:1–30. Chapters 21, 23, and 24 otherwise align.

key_decisions.decision: Keeps young men as actual agents rather than importing priests, with two offering types and bulls explicit; peace offerings matches 20:24.
Preserves actual blood on people, covenant-making and dependence on preceding words without adding later sacramental interpretation.
Preserves direct seeing and feet, comparative not exact pavement description, and sky clarity; ancient stone identification noted.
Keeps withheld hand, repeated seeing and meal without importing an explanation of how the vision was possible.
Retains stay, stone tablets, instruction/commandment pairing, divine writing and purpose to teach the people, making the pronoun’s referent clear without asserting a second document.
